Alger, 7 septembre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, September 7, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — The city of Oran has entered the global top 50 for mobile internet speed for the first time, joining Algiers in this ranking. According to the Ministry of Post and Telecommunications, this achievement places Algeria among the rare countries with two cities in this ranking.
Performance historique d'Oran et d'Alger: Historical performance of Oran and Algiers in the Ookla ranking
Selon un communiqué ministériel publié l: According to a ministerial press release published on Sunday, September 6, 2026, the Ookla platform updated its monthly data. Oran climbs twelve places to reach 41st place globally. Its speed index stands at 197.09 Mbps.
Alger se maintient dans ce classement au: Algiers maintains its position in this ranking at 42nd place globally. The capital records a slight drop of one place with an index of 194.57 Mbps.
L'Algérie rejoint ainsi un groupe restre: Algeria thus joins an exclusive group of nations boasting two cities in this top 50. This group includes Qatar, Saudi Arabia, the United States, China, South Korea, Belgium, Portugal, and Turkey. This development reflects the modernization of telecommunications infrastructure in several wilayas across the country.
Progression globale des débits internet: Overall progression of internet speeds in Algeria
Les performances nationales affichent ég: National performances also show a clear year-on-year increase. The average mobile internet speed almost doubled between July 2025 and July 2026.
L'internet fixe enregistre une tendance: Fixed internet is registering a similar trend. This improvement is explained by the continuous deployment of fiber optics across the various wilayas.
